[Mystery Manor](https://mysterymanor.net/housemap.htm) is for anyone who loves to play adventure games.  Each room is designed to be a place to find information, walkthroughs, screenshots, reviews or links, with a few surprises thrown in.  Or, you can explore the Manor just for the fun of it.

[Game Saves](https://mysterymanor.net/atticsavesn.htm)
